findings.proposed_design_change: Add separate cards for V12 pending plus pointer V13, invalid payload, unavailable peers, and cached-offline reopen; retain request/version identity and show author-follow/layer ledger unchanged or explicitly changed. Resolve the active-versus-interrupted wording on the acquisition card.
